acceptanceCriteria: An edit to a spec pinned by a use-case contract receipt that does not touch the receipt's claimed sections no longer fails TestUCV0ProfileMigration, or the failure names the exact repin command.
Two open PRs that both edit docs/specs/daily-change-evidence-workflow-v0.md no longer force each other to regenerate conformance/use-cases-v0 receipts and ledger.json after every merge.
The receipt still detects a substantive change to the evidence it attests; the chosen binding is recorded in the use-case conformance spec and BUILD-LOG.
body:
Filed 2026-09-23 while fixing CI on PRs #127, #130 and #133. conformance/use-cases-v0/receipts/*/contract.json pins the whole-file sha256 of docs/specs/daily-change-evidence-workflow-v0.md, and implementation.json pins source files such as cmd/corvint/local_completion.go; ledger.json pins each receipt's digest. Any edit to those files fails TestUCV0ProfileMigration (subject-digest-mismatch, conformance/use-cases-v0/main.go:363) even when the attested behaviour is unchanged, and repositoryRevision is only pattern-checked (:332). Every DCW-editing PR must repin, and each merge forces the remaining PRs to repin again. A mechanical repin (recompute subject digests, set repositoryRevision to HEAD, update ledger digests) was needed on four branches. Options: bind to requirement IDs or section digests, or ship a repin make target with a clear failure fix line.

Recurrence 2026-09-24: the tripwire reached main. Commit 793fc8a (decision 0376) edited docs/specs/daily-change-evidence-workflow-v0.md (sha256 44e9b24d... -> c7a069c3...) without repinning, and PR #140 merged it at 2026-09-24T12:15:46Z while its go-product job (Actions run 35997202483, started 12:08:38Z) was still in_progress; artifact-integrity and go-interop had passed. main then failed TestUCV0ProfileMigration for UC-CHANGE-CONSEQUENCE, UC-EVIDENCE-CARRYING-COMPLETION and UC-TASK-ORIENTATION until PR #145 repinned them (merge 72c614a, 12:45:43Z; same mechanical repin as 5675e30). PR #143, prepared independently in another session, carried byte-identical files and merged 20 s later as a content no-op, so two sessions spent the same repin. So a docs-only edit can merge the break before the job that runs go test reports; whether go-product is a required check was not verified.
title: conformance: use-case receipts pin whole-file digests, so every DCW spec edit forces a repin
